label: Guide me: My firm

params.name: lede
params.default: Get your firm approved in {product}, then bring in your team.
params.label: lede

default.title: Who you are
default.say: The first screen is just two cards: filing your own return (or your family HUF's), or running a CA practice. Pick the one that fits. Picked wrong? Use Not what you meant, choose again at the foot of the next page - nothing is lost.

default.title: Keep these ready
default.say: Before you start: every number and paper the firm needs, and where to find each. Each one is ticked as you give it.

default.title: Where you stand
default.say: The strip: details, papers, sent, approved.

default.title: Details
default.say: A CA firm gives PAN, TAN, GSTIN, FRN, the owner's last 4 Aadhaar digits and the mobile linked to its tax papers. An individual gives only name, PAN, mobile and email.

default.title: Papers and sending
default.say: A CA firm uploads the masked Aadhaar, PAN card, TAN letter and GST certificate, then sends them for approval. An individual has nothing to upload: Send opens the account at once and goes straight to New filing.

default.title: Your team
default.say: Once approved, add people with a role: partner, reviewer, auditor or preparer. A big team is one searched page at a time.
